B|Ulster County is seeking actuarial services for its pooled Self-Insurance Plan covering County Government, local municipalities, school districts, and volunteer firefighters.|p4.1|
B|The buyer is Ulster County Department of General Services, 100 Development Court, Kingston, NY 12401.|p1.h6,p1.h9,p1.h10|
B|Primary contact is Brenden Boughton, Principal Buyer, phone (845) 340-3999, email bbou@ulstercountyny.gov.|p2.1,p3.5|
B|The County seeks a qualified actuarial firm to provide an annual valuation of its self-insured workers compensation program.|p4.2|
B|The plan was established under Local Law #1 of 1979 and amended under Local Law #10 of 2008.|p4.8,p4.9|
B|The plan covers employees of the County, 20 towns, 3 villages, 7 school districts, 26 volunteer fire districts, 1 city, and Ulster County Community College.|p4.10|
B|The County administers the plan with County employees and a third-party administrator, under oversight of the County Executive.|p4.11|
B|The County has 1,609 employees, the community college has 342 employees, there are approximately 941 active volunteer firepersons, and approximately 5,745 government/local education employees.|p4.5|
B|There were 365 open workers’ compensation claims as of May 31, 2026.|p4.6|
C|The contract is for professional actuarial services under an agreement substantially conforming to the RFP and sample County Agreement for Professional Services.|p11.4|
